recommended_approach: Cloth with Wind + Property Weights pinning on a subdivided sheet

key_parameters.subdivisions: about 8 for a floppy, flexible fabric result
key_parameters.collision distance: keep small; increase only if clipping occurs
key_parameters.cache name: set a unique cache name to avoid cache filename collisions

warnings: Low subdivision gives stiff, blocky cloth; higher subdivision produces a floppier result.
Cloth collision settings are an accuracy-vs-speed tradeoff.
Enable self-collision if the sheet is self-penetrating during strong flapping.
If Cache Name is left unspecified, disk cache filenames can collide between systems.
External cache files require exact name and index matching.
alternative_approaches: Using Simulation to Shape/Sculpt a Mesh
